name: graph_auto_layout
description: N-4: the Graph canvas places itself. A node is dragged off its place, the canvas menu's 'Auto layout' entry is fired by name (a QAction, so no popup has to be driven), and the node comes back to exactly where the placement put it. The last step asks the live window how tangled the drawing is.
